第1行（所选荧光/标记策略 + 透明方法）：**[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647（胞体）, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647（轴突/树突）, TO-PRO-3（全脑核染）] + iDISCO+（DBE RI匹配）**

40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/水溶液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
1×PBS 浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
渗透液：PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M Glycine，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
封闭液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清（NDS），轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
一抗孵育液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS + 0.01% (w/v) NaN3；加入 NeuN (RBFOX3) 一抗 1:200。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)
同一孵育液中加入 β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) 一抗 1:300（与5.1可同管共孵育）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)
洗涤液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3，轻摇换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
重复 6.1 共 6 次（总洗涤约 36 hours）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)
二抗孵育液：PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 3% NDS + 0.01% NaN3；加入驴抗鼠/兔（按一抗宿主匹配）Alexa Fluor 647 二抗 1:400（分别对应NeuN与TUJ1；若两一抗宿主不同可同管共孵育）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days, Light: protected)
PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.01% NaN3 洗涤，轻摇换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
重复 8.1 共 6 次（总洗涤约 36 hours）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)
TO-PRO-3 1–2 µM（在PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100中），避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)
PBS 洗涤 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each)
20% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
40% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
60% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
80% 甲醇/水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
100% 甲醇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
新鲜 100% 甲醇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
66% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷(DCM)/33% 甲醇混合液浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
100% DCM 浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1.5 hours)
100% 二苄醚（DBE, RI≈1.56）预浸泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, Light: protected)
新鲜 100% DBE 继续浸泡至完全透明（全脑通常需要）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours, Light: protected)

第1行（所选荧光/标记策略 + 透明方法）：**[NeuN + Alexa Fluor 647（胞体）, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647（轴突/树突）, TO-PRO-3（全脑核染）] + iDISCO+（DBE RI匹配）**  
选择理由：iDISCO+ 适用于完整成年小鼠全脑（~10×8×6 mm）快速高透明化与光片成像；有机溶剂脱水/脱脂后透明度高、纤维束走行对比好；TO-PRO-3 与 Alexa Fluor 647 在iDISCO+流程中信号相对稳健，适合全脑三维神经元胞体与神经突起形态图谱构建。

光片成像前更换一次新鲜 DBE 并静置脱气泡/沉降。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours)
